{{Quote|Freeze!|Dyer, to Han Solo|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
'''Dyer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. As an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], he worked closely with [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who oversaw the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], while planning the defensive systems of a [[Endor shield generator bunker|bunker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The bunker, which [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|generated]] a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] for the unfinished [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], was under the supervision of Dyer, who was responsible for the defense of the installation.

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], hoping to destroy the bunker, a [[Endor strike team/Legends|group of Rebels]] infiltrated it and [[Battle of Endor/Legends|ambushed]] the Imperial [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] stationed there. Dyer then entered the base with his [[Troop/Legends|men]] in order to capture the intruders. When Dyer confronted [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Solo threw a toolbox filled with explosive charges at the colonel, causing him to fall over a platform railing.

==Biography==
===Death Star defense coordination===
[[File:EndorBunker-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|220px|The Endor shield generator bunker]]
Dyer,<ref name="Dyer">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Colonel Dyer}}</ref> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Force Collection" /> was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. At some point during his service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Dyer worked closely with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]],<ref name="CSWE Dyer" /> an Imperial militant who oversaw the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The two planned the defensive systems of an [[Endor shield generator bunker|installation]]<ref name="Dyer" /> that supplied a [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] for the unfinished [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

The bunker, which was located on the [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> was supervised by Dyer, who became responsible for completing the defense of the bunker.<ref name="Dyer" /> Dyer and Jerjerrod would also plan the deployment of ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on Endor,<ref name="FF" /> alongside [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Igar/Legends|Igar]]<ref name="Igar">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Commander Igar}}</ref> of the Imperial [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]] [[Legion/Legends|unit]].<ref name="Tempest Force CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|230|Tempest Force}}</ref> As part of another task, Dyer took part in commanding an elite group of [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] guarding the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Alongside Dyer's instruction to hold troops in reserve,<ref name="Dyer" /> the group consisted of members of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]],<ref name="CSWE Renz">{{CSWECite|III|93|Renz, Lieutenant}}</ref> Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Grond (Imperial)|Grond]]<ref name="Grond">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Grond}}</ref> and [[Renz/Legends|Renz]],<ref name="Renz">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Renz}}</ref> as well as the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Wallen]].<ref name="Wallen">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Sergeant Wallen}}</ref>

===Battle of Endor===
[[File:Dyer_FFGCG.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Dyer on Endor]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="FF" /> a [[Endor strike team/Legends|group]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members infiltrated the bunker to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]&mdash;which would allow the Rebels' [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|orbiting fleet]] to attack the Death Star itself. In order to stop the intruders, the Imperial group entered the base.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Dyer was joined by Renz<ref name="Renz" /> and Grond, who became the Imperial colonel's primary [[Aide/Legends|aide]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Rebel attack]].<ref name="CSWE Grond">{{CSWECite|I|371|Grond (2)}}</ref>

After the Rebel group ambushed the stationed Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] inside the bunker, Dyer confronted Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], pointing a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] at him and ordering him to freeze. However, Solo threw a toolbox full of explosive charges at Dyer, which caused the colonel to fall over the railing of a catwalk and into a generator room below,<ref name="ROTJ" /> resulting in his apparent [[Death/Legends|death]]. Following the event, Renz took command of the elite Imperial group.<ref name="GG" /> After later destroying the bunker and the orbiting Death Star, the Rebels won the Battle of Endor.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Dyer had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Skills and abilities==
Dyer possessed a degree of [[Force-attunement]]<ref name="Dyer" /> and [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]].<ref name="Press the Attack">{{FFGTCG|set=Press the Attack|cardname=Colonel Dyer|link=endor-cycle/press-the-attack/colonel-dyer-r1720}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Dyer wore the black variant of the [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]]. During the Battle of Endor, he wore the [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]] without [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaque]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In his possession, he had a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol<ref name="Dyer" /> and an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Battle for Endor|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBPBattleforEndor.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===''Return of the Jedi'' and character development===
{{Quote|I had the opportunity to play a very minor part in the film as an Imperial officer. In the Endor power station, who jumps out from behind a wall, at the power station, and holds a gun on Han Solo then gets hit with a toolbox and then falling into a generator room below. And my big line was 'Freeze!'&thinsp;|Ben Burtt, discussing his role in the ''Return of the Jedi'' audio commentary|<ref name="ROTJa">{{Film|VI}} [[Star Wars Trilogy (DVD)|DVD]] audio commentary</ref>}}
[[File:BenBurtt_Freeze.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Ben Burtt portrayed Dyer in ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
Dyer first appeared as an unnamed Imperial officer in [[Richard Marquand]]'s<ref name="ROTJa" /> [[May 25]], [[1983]]<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/critical-opinion-return-of-the-jedi-original-reviews|text=Critical Opinion: ''Return of the Jedi'' Original Reviews}}</ref> film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the [[original trilogy]]. [[Ben Burtt]], the sound designer for the film, was given a small role during production,<ref name="ROTJa" /> though his brief cameo was uncredited.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The interior bunker scenes took a day and a half of shooting and were filmed on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]]<ref name="MakingOfROTJ">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> on [[March 23]] and [[March 24|24]], [[1982]].<ref name="Shooting dates">''[[The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

In [[1999]], Dyer was featured in ''[[Endor Limited]]'', an expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. His card further established his character and identified him as "Colonel Dyer,"<ref name="Dyer" /> and his name was simultaneously mentioned on the Lieutenant Grond, Lieutenant Renz, and Sergeant Wallen cards from the set.<ref name="Grond" /><ref name="Renz" /><ref name="Wallen" /> The toy manufacturer [[Hasbro]] was originally going to include Dyer in a ''Return of the Jedi''&ndash;themed battle pack titled "Shield Generator Assault," but he was pulled from the set prior to its release<ref name="Hasbro shield">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|pack=Shield Generator Assault (Battle Packs)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBPShieldGeneratorAssault.asp}}</ref> in [[October]] [[2008]].<ref name="Jedi Business">{{WebCite|url=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/legacy/evg/Shield-Generator-Assault-The-Legacy-Collection-Battle-Packs.html|text=Shield Generator Assault (Hasbro - The Legacy Collection Battle Packs) - JediTempleArchives.com|work=[https://www.jeditemplearchives.com JediTempleArchives.com]|archivedate=20130623125030}}</ref>

===Filming===
{{Quote|The Imperial Officer they blow across the balcony in that sequence? I thought he was a stunt man, but he turned out to be a sound man!|Barrie Holland, discussing Ben Burtt's role as Dyer|<ref name="Insider96">{{InsiderCite|96|The Men Who Built the Empire}}</ref>}}
In the [[2004]] [[Star Wars Trilogy (DVD)|DVD release]] of ''Return of the Jedi'', Burtt commented about his cameo as Dyer in the audio commentary.<ref name="ROTJa" /> The scream that Dyer makes when he is knocked off the catwalk is meant to be an attempt at replicating the [[Wilhelm scream]], which Burtt, in his role as sound designer, attempted to include in all of the films on which he worked.<ref name="Insider105">{{InsiderCite|105|25 Years of Return of the Jedi!|25 Years of ''Return of the Jedi''!}}</ref>

Actor [[Barrie Holland]], who portrayed Lieutenant Renz in the film, recalled that shooting the scene that featured the characters Dyer and Renz was difficult due to Director Richard Marquand having conflicting views with his assistant director and first cameraman. Shooting the scene took "several beats" in order to get it right, and Holland believed that a stunt man played Dyer before finding out that Ben Burtt portrayed the character.<ref name="Insider96" />

===Appearance inconsistencies===
The Dyer character was not in the original revised third draft of ''Return of the Jedi''{{'s}} screenplay. In that version of the script, both Dyer's and Renz's lines were merged, and the person who shouts "Freeze! You Rebel scum" was identified simply as "Commander."<ref name="ROTJscipt">{{WebCite|url=http://www.scenebyscene.net/vi/rotjscript.txt|text=''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' Revised Third Draft|author=Lawrence Kasdan and George Lucas|date=01-04-1982|archivedate=20020623132600}}</ref> Similarly, Dyer's one line was spoken by Renz in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Cine-Manga|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' PhotoComic]],<ref name="comic">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Cine-Manga|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' Cine-Manga]]</ref> released [[April 23]], 2008.<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/15-014/Star-Wars-Episode-VI-Return-of-the-Jedi-Photo-Comic|text=Star Wars: Episode VI-Return of the Jedi Photo Comic}}</ref>

In [[1997]]'s ''[[Return of the Jedi Read-Along]]'', one of the Imperial troops on Endor is described as saying "Freeze, you Rebel scum." Similarly to the ''Return of the Jedi'' script's third draft, as that line is a merged version of Dyer and Renz's lines, this article avoids considering the ''Return of the Jedi Read-Along'' a confirmed appearance for either the Dyer or Renz characters.<ref name="read-along">''[[Return of the Jedi Read-Along]]''</ref>
